# Cobblemon Routes

**Turn any Cobblemon world into a classic-Pokémon-style RPG.** Cobblemon Routes generates **physical
routes** in the world-gen that connect your world's structures, layers automated **Hardcore Nuzlocke**
rules on top, and ties it all together with quality-of-life integrations — so exploring feels like a
real Pokémon region instead of an open sandbox.

Works on **any** Cobblemon install, and is compatible with modpacks (it auto-connects their gyms/towns).

---

## 🗺️ Dynamic routes (world-gen)
- **Automatic road network** between cities — villages by default, plus a 16-entry **Cities include**
  checklist (Cobblemon fossils, ruins, fishing boats, outposts, pyramids, mansions…) so YOU decide what
  the roads connect. Terrain-aware A\* paths, 3–5-block roads, built incrementally and resumed after a
  restart.
- **Every route has its own look** — by default each road picks its **own surface material**, and
  lighting (lamp posts, tunnel lanterns, underwater sea lanterns) is decided **per route**: most are
  lit, the occasional dark road keeps exploring spooky. All overridable.
- **Ring roads** — the network keeps closing loops between nearby towns, and every loop **encloses a
  named AREA** (A1, A2, … with nature names like *A3-Frostpine*).
- **Gyms next to towns** — with a gym-pack installed (e.g. COBBLEVERSE), every discovered city gets a
  **gym placed right beside it** instead of lost in the wilderness.
- **Mountain tunnels**, **water crossings** (open, swimmable channels with a paved, lit seabed and
  lane-marker rocks), **descriptive route names** (*Route 3: Plains Forest*), predicted city names,
  junction signs, and spawn-in-a-city.

## 🎮 Hardcore Nuzlocke (automated)
- **One capture per city, per route, per area** — the first-encounter lock follows the world's real
  geography, so growing the road network is how you earn new capture zones. Plus **permadeath**
  (a fainted Pokémon is permanently dead), **mandatory nicknames**, **Defeated Catch** (downed wilds
  stay catchable a while), **shiny clause**, modular **healing modes**, shared EXP, and a cooperative
  **Soullock** variant (consented soul-links, shared death).
- **Your run, on screen** — press **I** (or `/nuzlocke log`) for the **visited-zones log**: every zone
  with its coordinates, the Pokémon you met, how it went, and whether it still lives.
  `/nuzlocke soullock summary` shows every linked player's **full team**, even offline partners.
- **Route trainers** — NPC trainers stand along the roads (pick a **density**: Low → Brutal), challenge
  you on sight with the classic "!", and duel each other in ambient skirmishes with a proper standoff
  and a faint-the-loser finale.
- **Configured at world creation** — dedicated **NUZLOCKE** and **ROUTES** tabs on the create-world
  screen; choosing **Hardcore** auto-enables the full ruleset. All rules persist per world.

## 🧭 Integrations (optional)
- **Waystones** — activating a waystone registers it as a named city on the route network.
- **Xaero's Minimap & World Map** — named towns drop waypoints, and an optional layer **tints every
  chunk by its category**: magenta cities, orange routes, and teal **areas** that only paint once your
  roads truly enclose them. The world map carries its own **control column**: paint toggle, repaint,
  and **live intensity sliders** per category.

## ⚙️ Configuration
Everything is chosen on the **create-world tabs** (per world) or in the config JSON, with English &
Spanish labels — plus live map-paint sliders right on Xaero's world map.

---

## Compatibility
- **Minecraft 1.21.1** · **Fabric & NeoForge** · **Cobblemon 1.7.3** · **Java 21**

### Required
- Cobblemon · Fabric API (Fabric) · Architectury API · Cloth Config

### Optional
- Waystones · Xaero's Minimap · Xaero's World Map

## 🧭 Roadmap
- **1.1** — the **GLC (mono-type) challenge** mode, a map suite (instant paint overlay, **custom
  per-category colors** matched by the waypoints, markers for cities/routes/areas, load-and-discover
  map on demand) and **spawn pregeneration**.
- **1.2** — **JourneyMap** support.

> 🚀 Actively developed — new features land often, and the roadmap grows from player feedback.
